sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. March 17 launch describes mini as smaller/faster than full GPT-5.4 and reports capabilities, latency and benchmark scores, with no nominal total or active count and no named base of disclosed size. The mini availability section states a 400k API context, text/image input, function calling, tool search and computer use.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Mini API model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 through the official documentation fetch and fresh Markdown cache. Exact GPT-5.4 Mini snapshot gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 has 400,000 total context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input and text output. Reasoning efforts, function calling, prompt caching, file uploads and endpoints are documented; no numerical parameter count or structural base-model lineage is supplied.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card, Appendix: GPT-5.4 mini
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 PDF text read: mini Appendix 6, added March 17, includes exact mini safety, CoT controllability and preparedness evaluations (Tables 16-20). The full PDF contains no parameter term or numerical model-size disclosure. Full-size model training text is not a mini size specification.

sources.title: Investigating the consequences of accidentally grading CoT during RL
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The May 7 report explicitly identifies released GPT-5.4 mini and unintended CoT grading in less than 1.5% of its samples. It gives no numerical model size, active-parameter convention or disclosed-size base lineage.

sources.title: Self-replicating prompt injections exist
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. September 25 report identifies both attacker and defender as internal-only research checkpoints based on GPT-5.4-mini. It gives no count for those checkpoints or the released base; the named derivative relationship supplies no size to inherit.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full PDF text check of the April 23 card found no exact GPT-5.4 mini reference, parameter term or numerical model-size disclosure. Full-size comparisons cannot supply the mini count.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 full PDF text check of the July 9 card found no exact GPT-5.4 mini reference or numerical count. Parameter-string matches are unrelated hyperparameter tasks, not model size; successor and full-size specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and describes prompt caching through Transformer attention key/value projections. Combined with the exact mini caching feature, it supports a qualified broad Transformer-based inference, not a complete block inventory, dense/MoE classification or parameter counts.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses API PDF processing sends extracted text and page images to vision-capable models; Chat Completions also accepts PDF files. Combined with the exact mini vision, file-upload and endpoint support, this supports PDF as an API input format rather than an additional native sensory modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: March 17, 2026 explicitly releases gpt-5.4-mini to Chat Completions and Responses and documents tool search, built-in computer use and compaction.

sources.title: Model Release Notes
sources.evidence: The March 18, 2026 entry announces ChatGPT rollout of GPT-5.4 mini through Thinking for Free/Go and as a paid-user fallback. This product rollout note does not override the March 17 API launch.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Current deprecation notices were searched for the exact GPT-5.4 mini identifier and dated snapshot; no notice was found. Notices for GPT-5 Mini or other GPT variants do not establish a mini shutdown.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant nonexclusive service/API use and reserve ownership of the services. This supports a descriptive proprietary hosted-service classification, not an open-weight license. The page was accessed through the web index after a direct HTTP fetch returned 403.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: The official inventory lists GPT-5.4 Mini as a hosted model, distinct from its Open-weight models section listing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b under Apache 2.0. The checked release and exact-model documentation offer no mini weights.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-5.4 mini record
sources.evidence: Original catalog source was inspected as a lead. Its descriptive and capability assertions were independently checked against primary sources.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card — GPT-5.4 mini appendix
sources.evidence: Reopened original HTML appendix October 27 and checked alongside the freshly fetched PDF. Mini-specific evaluations supply no nominal total, active count or disclosed-size named base; benchmark percentages and capability thresholds are not counts.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity, v2
sources.evidence: Original July 5 revision reopened October 27. Abstract and Section 6.3 characterize the output as calibrated effective knowledge capacity with wide prediction bands. Appendix E Table 15 exactly lists gpt-5.4-mini with dashes for Params, IKP Pred. and architecture; it supplies no active-count column. Behavioral capacity and fingerprint-derived lineage are not literal model-count disclosures.

sources.title: Scientific Reports DOI 10.1038/s41598-026-52167-6 — parameter-table search lead
sources.evidence: Fresh search surfaced an exact GPT-5.4 mini row with an unspecified parameter value, but PDF and article retrieval redirected to an inaccessible identity endpoint. This unopened lead is not used to establish a count or a negative source finding.

name.note: Use the capitalization of the official API display name.

developer.note: OpenAI publishes the model and its original system-card appendix.

family.note: Normalize the named generation; mini remains the exact variant and does not imply shared weights with full-size or nano models.

release_date.note: Explicit original API/Codex launch and mini appendix are March 17. The March 18 ChatGPT rollout entry is a distinct product note. The default dated API snapshot is also March 17.

open_weights.note: Checked primary release/model pages distribute this model through hosted services, not downloadable weights; official open-weight inventory lists separate gpt-oss models.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification with reserved service IP, not an SPDX identifier or downloadable-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit reopened original launch/docs/mini appendix, later exact-model RL research and GPT-5.5/5.6 cards. No nominal total or developer-named base with a disclosed count was found. IKP Table 15 leaves the exact mini count unspecified; calibrated effective capacity is not a literal parameter specification. Bounded exact-model first-party and original-research searches found no supported newer count.

active_parameters_b.note: Checked separately for an explicit active-count convention in original/later sources and fresh exact-model activated-parameter searches; none was found. IKP has no mini active count and its behavioral estimates cannot establish one. Smaller/faster descriptions, benchmark percentages, dense assumptions and other family variants supply no count to inherit.

architecture.note: Qualified cross-source inference: exact mini documentation explicitly supports prompt caching and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 technical guide explains Transformer attention KV state. This supports broad Transformer-based classification only. Original/later cards and targeted training/interpretability checks do not establish complete block composition, dense/MoE layout or parameter counts.

context_window.note: Original announcement and current exact-model documentation agree on 400,000 total tokens; the API separately specifies 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. No full-size 1M context is transferred, and compaction does not enlarge a single context window.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output. PDF is included as an API document format processed into text and page images. The hosted image-generation tool does not establish native image output.

reasoning.note: Exact model supports reasoning tokens and none (default), low, medium, high and xhigh effort. The mini appendix and later exact-model RL report independently describe its CoT; default none does not negate reasoning capability.

tool_call.note: Exact mini documentation explicitly supports function calling, tool search and computer use; no nano or full-size behavior is assumed.

description.value: OpenAI model for coding and computer use, with configurable reasoning, text and image inputs, and tool calling.
description.note: Replace promotional performance claims with documented purpose, inputs and capabilities.

patch.notes: Released March 17, 2026 in the API and Codex; a March 18 release note describes the ChatGPT rollout. Current default API snapshot is gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17. The 400,000-token context has separate 272,000-token input and 128,000-token output maxima. Reasoning supports none, low, medium, high and xhigh. PDF denotes API extraction into text and page images; image generation uses a hosted tool. Transformer is a qualified inference from exact mini prompt-caching support and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 KV-cache documentation. Detailed topology and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed; calibrated effective-knowledge estimates are not model specifications. No exact API deprecation notice was found; current endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Parameter-only re-audit: retain total and active parameters as undisclosed, with explicit null patches. Reopened launch, current exact-model documentation, mini appendix, later OpenAI RL research and GPT-5.5/5.6 cards; fresh bounded searches found no nominal count or disclosed-size named-base inference. Original IKP research leaves the mini count unspecified and measures effective knowledge capacity. Preserve the other 12 field assessments.
